name: Meshach
overview: The name Meshach, given by the chief eunuch to Mishael, identifies one of the three Hebrew young men who remained faithful to God while serving in Babylon (Daniel 1:7). Alongside Shadrach and Abednego, Meshach was entrusted with significant responsibilities in the province of Babylon (Daniel 2:49) and stood firm in refusing to worship the king's golden image, boldly trusting in God's deliverance even under threat of death by a fiery furnace (Daniel 3:12-15). These passages highlight Meshach's role as a faithful witness to God's power and sovereignty in a hostile environment.
